biotools.summary: cLDLA is a Nextflow workflow for performing combined linkage disequilibrium and linkage analysis (cLDLA) to identify the genetic basis of complex traits. It requires a VCF file and phenotype file as input and includes workflows for SNP-based heritability estimation and result visualization.
biotools.name: cLDLA
